structure containing cobalt in its rings. Th e vitamin is a cofac-
tor for methionine synthase and methylmalonyl CoA mutase.

methyltetrahydrofolate (mTHF—active folate) to homocysteine
and for conversion of succinyl Co-A. An insuﬃ  cient amount of 
B12 results in megaloblastic anemia, neuropathies, and homo-
